dedupe_keys.name: bea industry economic accounts us input output supply use and requirements tables gdp and gross output by industry klems production account

description: The official US accounts of how industries buy from and sell to each other. The BEA page says the Industry Economic Accounts, presented in an input-output framework and as annual output by industry, show the relationships between US producers and users and each industry's contribution to production, with products for GDP by industry, gross output by industry, input-output accounts, employment by industry and an integrated industry-level production account (KLEMS) built with the Bureau of Labor Statistics that traces growth to capital, labour, intermediate inputs and total factor productivity. The input-output page says supply-use, make-use-import, total and domestic requirements, direct requirements and market share tables and historical make-use tables are served through BEA's interactive data applications, from which tables can be downloaded free of charge; the licence is not stated on the pages read. Coverage is the United States by industry. Caveats: national tables only, and industry detail and years vary by table. For simulation it gives the inter-industry coefficients that input-output and inoperability models use to spread an outage at one industry to its customers and suppliers. Related catalogue records include the Eurostat supply, use and input-output tables and EXIOBASE.
